title: Advanced Relative Pronouns: aki, ami, amely, amelyik

sections.title: Differentiating Relative Pronouns in Descriptions
sections.content: When characterizing towns and people, choose the appropriate relative pronoun: *aki* (referring to people), *ami* (referring to whole clauses or indefinite concepts), *amely* (formal relative pronoun referring to specific things/places), and *amelyik* (selecting one specific item from a set).

items.spanish: Ez az a csendes kisváros, amely kiváló infrastruktúrával rendelkezik.
items.english: This is the quiet small town that has excellent infrastructure.

items.spanish: Azok a helyi lakosok, akik itt élnek, nagyra becsülik a tiszta levegőt.
items.english: Those local residents who live here greatly value the clean air.

items.spanish: Minden alapvető szolgáltatás elérhető, ami nagyon kényelmessé teszi a mindennapokat.
items.english: All basic services are available, which makes daily life very convenient.
